# Copilot instructions

Preserve owner control, portability, least privilege, and project isolation.

When editing code:
- make the smallest safe change;
- do not invent credentials or secret values;
- never commit tokens, private keys, keystores, or .env files;
- keep external AI providers replaceable;
- preserve explicit authorization for high-impact actions;
- add or update tests for security-sensitive behavior;
- pin GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs;
- report uncertainty instead of fabricating PASS evidence.

Do not copy proprietary code from reference APKs. Observable behavior may be converted into requirements and independently implemented.
